summary.text: Omy Maldonado is the Republican candidate for Pennsylvania State Senate District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Democrat Nick Miller.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran and management consultant, he also sought the Republican nomination for the same seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Omy Maldonado was born in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, and served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2009 to 2017.

He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of South Carolina Beaufort in 2017 and an MBA from St. Joseph's University in 2021, and his career experience includes working as a management consultant.
Maldonado ran in the Republican primary for Pennsylvania State Senate District 14 on May 17, 2022, which Dean Browning won, and he advanced from the Republican primary for the seat on May 19, 2026.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father of three and Marine Corps veteran who grew up in poverty, and he listed school choice, election integrity and community safety as his key messages.
